_readme: Context for translators. Read by tools/i18n/i18n.mjs when it writes a commented translation template. Edit freely: sections = what a group of keys is (longest key prefix wins), placeholders = what {name} stands for, keys = notes for single keys, glossary = core game terms (value = i18n key whose existing translations are shown as reference).

app.title: App name and meta
app.note: Name and tagline of the app. Keep 'Pips & Paws' untranslated.

common.title: Common words
common.note: Short words reused in many places (OK, Cancel, or ...).

header.title: Top bar
header.note: Buttons and tooltips in the header. Mostly icon buttons with a tooltip; keep short.

skin.title: Skin names
skin.note: Look of the sheet: 'Classic' app look, 'Print sheet' like a printed character sheet.

panel.title: Panel buttons
panel.note: Collapse / expand / drag handle of the sheet panels.

nav.title: Jump bar
nav.note: Bottom bar that scrolls to a section. Each label sits under a small icon: keep to one short word (about 12 characters at most).

sheet.title: Character sheet
sheet.note: Fields of the identity panel (name, background, birthsign ...).

attr.title: Attributes
attr.note: STR / DEX / WIL, current and maximum, and the 'Save' button of an attribute.

res.title: Resources
res.note: Hit protection (HP), pips (money), XP, level and grit.

dice.title: Dice roller
dice.note: The player's dice panel and save rolls. 'Save' is the d20 roll-under-attribute check of Mausritter.

inv.title: Inventory
inv.note: Paws, body and pack slots; add-item dialog.

item.title: Item cards
item.note: Texts on an item card: damage, defence, usage dots, rename, rolls.

type.title: Item types
type.note: Weapon, armour, spell, condition ... shown as a small tag.

icon.title: Icon picker
icon.note: Dialog to choose a symbol for an item.

wizard.title: Character creation wizard
wizard.note: Five steps following the Mausritter rules: attributes, HP and pips, background, weapon, details.

rest.title: Resting
rest.note: Short rest = 1 Turn, long rest = 1 Watch, full rest = 1 week.

levelup.title: Level up
levelup.note: Banner and result of advancing a level.

zero.title: Attribute at 0
zero.note: What it means when DEX or WIL reaches zero.

enc.title: Encumbrance
enc.note: More items than slots: no running, disadvantage on saves.

dmg.title: Damage messages
dmg.note: Messages when the GM deals damage (armour, damage to an attribute).

fight.title: After the fight
fight.note: Rolls a d6 per used weapon/armour/ammo to mark usage.

spell.title: Spellcasting
spell.note: Casting a spell with a power of 1-3, usage, miscasts and recharging.

repair.title: Repairs
repair.note: Paying pips to repair weapons and armour.

donate.title: Donating pips
donate.note: Spending pips selflessly on the community gives XP.

bank.title: Bank
bank.note: Storing pips and items in a settlement; 1% fee when retrieving.

pips.title: Pips and purses
pips.note: Carrying more than 250 pips needs pip purses.

stash.title: Shared stash (table centre)
stash.note: A common loot pile / cart / chest that GM and players share.

hirelings.title: Hirelings
hirelings.note: Hired helpers with their own stats and inventory.

portrait.title: Portrait
portrait.note: Uploading a picture of the mouse.

roster.title: Saved mice
roster.note: List of mice stored in the browser.

party.title: Party view
party.note: What players see about each other.

group.title: Group overview
group.note: Compact view of the party shared by the GM.

npcs.title: NPCs on the table
npcs.note: Non-player characters the GM has made visible.

handout.title: Handouts
handout.note: Texts and pictures the GM shows to players.

gm.title: GM dashboard
gm.note: Everything the Game Master sees: players, actions, logs.

gm.log.title: GM log lines
gm.log.note: One line per event in the live log. {name} is usually a player's mouse.

gm.sound.title: Soundboard
gm.sound.note: Sound effects and uploaded music played for the whole table.

gm.kick.title: Removing a player
gm.kick.note: Remove a player from the room and block the device.

gm.secret.title: Secret rolls
gm.secret.note: A switch: the GM's rolls are not shown to players.

player.title: Messages to the player
player.note: Notifications a player gets when the GM acts (damage, healing, items ...).

time.title: Time and light tracker
time.note: Turn / Watch / Day counter, torches, random encounters.

combat.title: NPC and combat tracker
combat.note: Creatures with HP, STR and attacks; morale checks.

luck.title: Luck rolls
luck.note: X-in-6 chance: roll a d6, equal or under X means it happens.

loot.title: Loot to XP
loot.note: Treasure brought home gives XP to the party.

gen.title: Generators
gen.note: Random tables (weather, NPCs, hexes, settlements, adventure sites). The table content itself is in src/data/, not here.

fac.title: Factions
fac.note: Faction tracker of the Mausritter GM tools.

map.title: Battle map
map.note: Map image with grid, tokens, drawing tools and fog of war.

mp.title: Multiplayer
mp.note: Hosting and joining a room over peer-to-peer WebRTC. 'GM' = Game Master / Spielleiter.

mp.sec.title: Room security
mp.sec.note: Optional password and 'approve joins' for the room.

mp.pending.title: Join requests
mp.pending.note: The GM allows or denies a new device.

mp.pw.title: Password prompt
mp.pw.note: Shown to a player when the room has a password.

pnp.title: PenNodePaper link
pnp.note: Bridge to the world-building tool PenNodePaper (product name, do not translate).

hint.title: Info hints
hint.note: Text shown in the little (i) pop-overs.

help.title: Help window
help.note: Longer explanatory paragraphs. Lines separated by \n are kept as paragraphs.

footer.title: Footer
footer.note: Links and legal lines at the bottom of the page. Keep the licence names (MIT, CC BY 4.0) as they are.

confirm.title: Confirmations
confirm.note: Questions before something is deleted or overwritten.

placeholders.name: a name: a mouse, a player, an item or a spell
placeholders.attr: the name of an attribute: STR / DEX / WIL (already translated)
placeholders.result: a short result phrase such as 'success' or 'hold' (already translated)
placeholders.roll: the number rolled on a die
placeholders.d: the number rolled on a d20 or d6
placeholders.x: the X of an 'X-in-6' luck roll (1 to 5)
placeholders.amount: an amount of damage / healing / pips / XP
placeholders.label: the name of a roll, e.g. 'd6'
placeholders.got: pips actually received after the fee
placeholders.text: free text typed by the GM
placeholders.s: a number: damage that went to STR
placeholders.kind: a kind: rest type or an unsupported item kind
placeholders.code: a room code such as K49W5W
placeholders.cond: the name of a condition (Injured, Exhausted ...)
placeholders.ammo: the name of an ammunition item
placeholders.target: a target number to roll under
placeholders.extra: an optional suffix such as ' → DEX (minus armour)' (already translated, may be empty). Keep it directly after the text, no space

keys.app.title: Product name — keep 'Pips & Paws'.
keys.attr.save: Button text on an attribute box: roll a d20, equal or under the attribute = success. English 'Save' is the official Mausritter term; use the term of the official translation if one exists.
keys.attr.saveShort: Very short form of 'Save'. Used where space is tight.
keys.dice.save: Label before the three attribute buttons (STR / DEX / WIL).
keys.dice.saveVs: {attr} is already translated. Result: e.g. 'Save: Strength (STR)'.
keys.res.grit: Mausritter term 'Grit': ignores Conditions. Official German: 'Mumm'.
keys.res.hp: Mausritter term 'Hit Protection (HP)': the damage a mouse shrugs off before real harm reaches STR. Existing translations differ; pick the wording of the official translation if there is one.
keys.res.pips: Mausritter currency 'pips'. Keep the word 'Pips' unless the official translation differs.
keys.mp.host: Button: open a room as the Game Master.
keys.mp.title: Window title.
keys.mp.sec.help: Explains that without protection anyone who knows the 6-character room code can join.
keys.mp.sec.linkPwHint: '#' is the hash character in a web address; the part behind it never reaches a server.
keys.gm.dashboard: Heading of the GM view; followed by ' · N connected'.
keys.gm.log.dead: A mouse's STR reached 0 = the mouse is dead. Tone: sober, a little dramatic is fine.
keys.gm.log.luck: Luck roll result line; {result} is the translated 'It happens' / 'It doesn't happen'.
keys.luck.yes: Result of a luck roll: the event happens.
keys.luck.no: Result of a luck roll: the event does not happen.
keys.spell.power: Button: cast the spell with power {n} (1-3). 'Power' is the Mausritter term.
keys.spell.sumDice: Contains the literal markers [SUM] and [DICE] in English. Keep the square brackets and use the same words your language uses in the spell texts of the rulebook if you translated them.
keys.dmg.armour: Short parenthetical: how much damage armour absorbed.
keys.time.watch: Mausritter time unit 'Watch' = 36 Turns (about 6 hours). Not a wristwatch.
keys.time.turn: Mausritter time unit 'Turn' = about 10 minutes of exploration. Not 'whose turn it is'.
keys.stash.title: 'Table centre': a shared loot pile between GM and players.
keys.footer.disclaimer1: Legal text required by the licence: it is intentionally left in English in every language. Do not translate.
keys.footer.disclaimer2: Legal text required by the licence: it is intentionally left in English in every language. Do not translate.

glossary.note: A buffer: damage goes here first, then to STR.
d20 roll under the attribute; official Mausritter wording.
The three kinds of inventory slots.
Negative effects that occupy an inventory slot (Exhausted, Frightened, Hungry, Injured, Drained, Encumbered).
